q04.
APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go

That method implements `AuthService.SignIn` (`APIV1Service` embeds `UnimplementedAuthServiceServer` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`). `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` only delegates to it.
